scope: local pinned primary source observations; no upstream implementation copied
observations: PlayWAVetable.c defines byte address register 0x14 and data register 0x10; numeric 32-bit writes consume MSB-first packed bytes on the Amiga.
Utility uses separate mono streams per voice and 8/16-bit representations.
Public card descriptor supplies agus_WavetableBase and reservation flag AMIGUS_FLAG_WAVETABLE=2.
Public SFD provides no sample RAM allocation/upload API; no capacity is accepted as verified from the utility.
Native Mini bus access, physical capacity and voice stop confirmation remain unqualified.
